orderEdit.title: Edit sales order
orderEdit.intro: Revise a draft or rejected order. Saving a rejected order returns it to Draft and keeps its approval history.
orderEdit.blocked: Only manual Draft or Rejected orders without deliveries can be edited.
orderEdit.blockedPending: This order is pending approval and cannot be edited.
orderEdit.blockedApproved: This order is approved and cannot be edited.
orderEdit.blockedCancelled: This order is cancelled and cannot be edited.
orderEdit.blockedConverted: This order was created from a quotation and cannot be edited.
orderEdit.blockedDelivered: This order has a delivery or pending reserved quantity and cannot be edited.
orderEdit.conflict: The order changed. Your input is kept; refreshing will replace it with the latest saved version.
orderEdit.unavailable: This order may have been deleted or may be outside your edit scope. Refresh the saved order before deciding what to do next.
orderEdit.unknown: The update result is uncertain. Read the saved version before trying again.
orderEdit.noChange: No data changed. Nothing was sent.
orderEdit.rejected: The server rejected the order change. Check the reason below and correct the form before trying again.

orderCreate.unknownCreateOnly: The save result is uncertain. You cannot view orders; ask a colleague with order access to verify it before trying again.
orderCreate.serverUncertain: System error. The order may have been saved. Verify the result before taking another action.
orderCreate.taxRequired: Choose a valid output tax rate.
orderCreate.oneLineMinimum: An order needs at least one line.
orderCreate.lineLimit: You can add up to 1,000 lines.
orderCreate.title: Create sales order
orderCreate.intro: Save a manual draft or convert an approved quotation. The server assigns the number.
orderCreate.unknown: The save result is uncertain. Check saved orders before creating another.
orderCreate.rejected: The server rejected this order. Review the reason below and correct the form before trying again.
orderCreate.convertHint: Choose an approved quotation to create a linked order.
orderCreate.unsaved: Leave this page? Unsaved order entries will be lost.
orderCreate.customerInactive: Customer is inactive. Choose an active customer.
orderCreate.quotationUnavailable: Quotation is unavailable. Choose an approved quotation.
orderCreate.serverField: Review this field and try again.

order.title: Sales orders
order.timeout: Request timed out. Check your connection and retry.
order.invalidDates: Enter valid dates with From on or before To.
order.exportScope: Exports saved lines of the orders matching the applied filters, in the current language.
order.exportBusy: Export in progress. Wait for it to finish.
order.exportWaitLoad: Wait for the order list to finish loading.
order.exportNeedsList: Load the order list successfully before exporting.
order.exportNoRows: No orders match the applied filters, so there is nothing to export.
order.exportEmpty: No order lines within your export scope match the applied filters. No file was downloaded.
order.exportIncomplete: The export file was incomplete or its row count did not match. No file was downloaded; retry.
order.exportDenied: You do not have permission to export sales orders.
order.exportLimit: The export exceeds 10,000 order lines. Narrow the filters and try again.
order.exportInvalid: The export filters are invalid. Check the dates and status and try again.
order.exportFailed: The export failed. Retry; if it fails again, give the trace ID to support.
order.exportTimeout: The export timed out. No file was downloaded; check your connection and retry.
order.exportNoOrders: There are no orders yet, so there is nothing to export.

quotation.title: Sales quotations
quotation.timeout: Request timed out. Check your connection and retry.
quotation.invalidDates: Enter valid dates with From on or before To.

quotationCreate.name: Name
quotationCreate.conflict: The quotation or reference changed. Review your entries and retry.

validation.remark: Remark must be at most 500 characters.
validation.taxRateId: Enter a valid output tax rate ID.
validation.expiryDate: Enter a valid expiry date on or after the document date.
validation.currencyCode: Enter a three-letter uppercase currency code.
validation.quantity: Enter a positive quantity below 10^13 with up to 6 decimals.
validation.lines: Enter 1 to 1000 lines with unique numbers.
validation.unitPrice: Enter a nonnegative price below 10^13 with up to 6 decimals.
validation.lineNo: Line number must be positive and unique.
validation.serverField: Review the rejected field and try again.
validation.mixedCurrency: All quotation lines must use the same currency.

quotationCreate.rejected: The server rejected a referenced customer, item, currency or tax rate. Review the fields and retry.
quotationCreate.intro: Save a draft. The server assigns the number and calculates saved totals.
quotationCreate.title: Create sales quotation
quotationCreate.unsaved: Leave this page? Unsaved quotation entries will be lost.
quotationCreate.outcomeUnknown: Save result is unknown. Check the quotation list before creating another draft.

quotationEdit.conflict: This quotation changed. Your entries are still here. Refresh to load the latest saved version; this will replace your entries.
quotationEdit.title: Edit sales quotation
quotationEdit.intro: Revise a saved Draft or Rejected quotation. Saving a Rejected quotation returns it to Draft and keeps approval history.
quotationEdit.blocked: Only Draft and Rejected quotations can be edited.
quotationEdit.outcomeUnknown: Update result is unknown. Check the saved quotation before trying again.

delivery.title: Sales outbound
delivery.timeout: Request timed out. Check your connection and retry.
delivery.invalidDates: Enter valid dates with From on or before To.
delivery.stateDraft: Draft: no order balance is reserved and no stock has changed.
delivery.statePending: Pending approval: these quantities reserve the order balance. Stock changes only when the final approval posts the delivery.
delivery.stateRejected: Rejected: no order balance is reserved and no stock has changed. Revise and resubmit, or delete the draft.
delivery.statePosted: Posted: stock was issued through inventory with the movement IDs below. A posted delivery cannot be edited or deleted; correct it with a sales return.

action.submitConfirm: The saved version is submitted. While pending approval it reserves the order balance. If no approval step applies, it is posted at once and stock is issued.
action.withdrawConfirm: The approval round is cancelled and the outbound returns to Draft. The order balance is no longer reserved; stock does not change.
action.deleteConfirm: The draft is deleted. No order balance or stock is affected. This cannot be undone.
action.submitted: Outbound {{number}} was submitted and is pending approval (version {{version}}). Stock has not changed yet.
action.posted: Outbound {{number}} needed no approval and was posted; stock was issued (version {{version}}).
action.withdrawn: Outbound {{number}} was withdrawn to Draft (version {{version}}). The order balance is no longer reserved.
action.deleted: Draft {{number}} was deleted. No order balance or stock was affected.
action.unknown: We could not confirm the result. Refresh to see the saved state before trying again.
action.serverError: The server could not process the request.
action.conflict: Someone else changed this outbound. Refresh to see the latest version, then try again.
action.unavailable: This outbound no longer exists or is outside your data scope. Refresh to check.
action.statusChanged: The outbound status has changed. Refresh to see the current state.
action.lineRejected: The server refused line {{number}}; the reason is shown under that line.
action.linesRejected: The server refused lines {{numbers}}; the reason is shown under those lines.
action.submitUnchanged: Nothing was saved: the outbound is still Draft, no order balance is reserved and stock has not changed.
action.withdrawUnchanged: Nothing was saved: the outbound is still pending approval.
action.stockHint: Check each line's warehouse, location and lot/serial stock, edit the draft if needed, then submit again.
action.rejectedHint: A rejected outbound must be edited and saved (it returns to Draft) before it can be submitted again.

deliveryCreate.title: New sales outbound
deliveryCreate.intro: Saving creates a Draft: it does not reserve order balance and does not reduce stock. Submitting reserves the balance; stock is issued only when final approval posts it.
deliveryCreate.orderNotApproved: This order is no longer Approved, so no outbound can be created for it. Choose another order.
deliveryCreate.noBalance: Every line of this order is fully used by posted or pending outbounds, so there is nothing left to ship.
deliveryCreate.balanceHint: These balances were read when the order loaded. Other outbounds submitted or posted meanwhile change them; the server rechecks on save and on submit.
deliveryCreate.locationNeedsWarehouse: Choose a warehouse before choosing a location.
deliveryCreate.oneLineMinimum: An outbound needs at least one line.
deliveryCreate.saved: Outbound draft {{number}} saved. Stock has not changed.
deliveryCreate.unknown: We could not confirm whether the draft was saved (timeout, network or server error). Search the outbound list first and create it again only if no new draft is there, to avoid duplicates.
deliveryCreate.unknownCreateOnly: We could not confirm whether the draft was saved (timeout, network or server error). You cannot view outbounds, so ask a colleague who can to check before creating it again.
deliveryCreate.serverUncertain: The server reported an error; we could not confirm whether the draft was saved.
deliveryCreate.lineRejected: The server refused the highlighted line and nothing was saved. Correct that line and save again.
deliveryCreate.rejected: The server refused to save; nothing changed.
deliveryCreate.unsaved: This outbound has not been saved. Leave anyway?

validation.decimal: Enter a quantity above 0 with up to 13 integer and 6 decimal digits.
validation.aboveRemaining: The lines for this order line add up to more than its available balance.
validation.belowTracking: This quantity is less than the saved lot/serial total on this line. Increase it, or change the selections first.
validation.trackingNumber: Each row needs one lot number (up to 50 characters) or one serial number (up to 100 characters).
validation.trackingQuantity: Each lot quantity must be a positive number with up to 6 decimals; each serial counts as exactly 1.
validation.trackingDuplicate: The same lot or serial number appears twice on this line (case is ignored).

deliveryCreate.trackingHint: Some lines need lot or serial numbers. Pick them from stock on the edit page; they must be complete before submission.
deliveryCreate.trackingHintNoEdit: Some lines need lot or serial numbers, but you cannot edit deliveries. Ask a colleague who can to pick them on the edit page before submission.
deliveryCreate.pickOnEdit: Pick lots/serials on the edit page

deliveryEdit.title: Edit sales outbound
deliveryEdit.intro: Revise a Draft or Rejected outbound. Saving replaces every line and leaves it in Draft: no order balance is reserved and stock does not change. Delete is available only for Draft.
deliveryEdit.rejectedHint: This outbound was rejected. Saving returns it to Draft; it must be submitted again for approval.
deliveryEdit.blocked: Only Draft or Rejected outbounds can be edited.
deliveryEdit.blockedPending: This outbound is pending approval and cannot be edited. Withdraw it from the outbound list detail first.
deliveryEdit.blockedPosted: This outbound is posted and cannot be edited or deleted; correct it with a sales return.
deliveryEdit.orderNotApproved: The source order is no longer Approved. You can still delete this draft, but saving changes will be refused.
deliveryEdit.balanceHint: These balances were read when the page loaded. A Draft reserves nothing, so this outbound is not counted in them; the server rechecks on submit.
deliveryEdit.trackingKept: This item's current tracking mode could not be read, so its saved lot/serial selections are kept unchanged on save.
deliveryEdit.saved: Outbound {{number}} was saved as version {{version}}. It is a Draft; stock has not changed.
deliveryEdit.noChange: No data changed. Nothing was sent.
deliveryEdit.refreshDiscards: Refreshing replaces your unsaved entries with the saved version. Continue?
deliveryEdit.conflict: Someone else changed this outbound. Your entries are still shown but cannot be saved; refresh to load the latest version (this replaces your entries).
deliveryEdit.unavailable: This outbound was not found. It may have been deleted or be outside your data scope. Refresh to check.
deliveryEdit.statusChanged: This outbound is no longer Draft or Rejected (it may have been submitted, posted or deleted). Refresh to see its current status.
deliveryEdit.unknown: We could not confirm whether your changes were saved (timeout, network or server error). Refresh to read the saved version before trying again.
deliveryEdit.deleteUnknown: We could not confirm whether the outbound was deleted (timeout, network or server error). Refresh to check before trying again.
deliveryEdit.lineRejected: The server refused the highlighted line and nothing was saved. Correct that line and save again.
deliveryEdit.rejected: The server refused to save; nothing changed.
deliveryEdit.deleteRejected: The server refused to delete this outbound; nothing changed.
deliveryEdit.deleteConfirm: The draft will be removed. No order balance or stock is affected.
deliveryEdit.deleteConfirmDirty: The draft will be removed, including your unsaved changes. No order balance or stock is affected.
deliveryEdit.deleteDraftOnly: Only a Draft can be deleted. Save it first to return it to Draft.
deliveryEdit.deleted: Outbound {{number}} was deleted. No order balance or stock was affected.
deliveryEdit.unsaved: Your changes to this outbound are not saved. Leave anyway?
deliveryEdit.staleHint: Saving and deleting are paused until you refresh the saved outbound (see the message above).
deliveryEdit.trackingIncomplete: a Draft may be saved incomplete, but before submission the selections must equal the outbound quantity.
deliveryEdit.availabilityHint: You can also type them; stock is checked only at approval and posting.
deliveryEdit.stockHint: Lists lots or serials in stock at this line's current warehouse/location (saved or not).
deliveryEdit.stockNeedsWarehouse: Choose a warehouse first to pick from stock.
deliveryEdit.stockNeedsQuantity: Enter a valid outbound quantity first to pick from stock.
deliveryEdit.stockDescription: Shows on-hand stock at this line's warehouse/location now, not reserved for this delivery. Other draft or pending deliveries may pick the same lot; stock is checked again at approval and posting. Lots are listed by earliest expiry.
deliveryEdit.stockTruncated: Only the first 100 are shown. Enter a keyword to narrow the list.
deliveryEdit.stockModeChanged: This item's tracking mode changed or the item was deleted, so you cannot pick from stock. Refresh the saved delivery.
deliveryEdit.stockKeywordTooLong: The keyword is too long (lots up to 50, serials up to 100 characters); nothing was searched.
deliveryEdit.stockDuplicate: {{count}} already on this line, not added again.
deliveryEdit.stockFull: {{count}} not added because the outbound quantity is already reached.
deliveryEdit.stockRelocated: The warehouse or location changed. The selected lots/serials may not be at the new place; check them or pick from stock again.

priceRule.activeItemsOnly: Only active items are listed; to find rules of an inactive item, search without an item.
priceRule.activeCustomersOnly: Only active, approved customers are listed.
priceRule.title: Price rules
priceRule.intro: Dated selling prices by item and currency. A customer rule takes precedence over the company default rule on the document date; saved quotations and orders keep their own price snapshots.
priceRule.name: Name
priceRule.timeout: Request timed out. Check your connection and retry.
priceRule.loadFailed: Could not load price rules. Retry.
priceRule.noResults: No price rules match these filters.
priceRule.invalidCurrency: Enter a three-letter currency code, such as TWD.
priceRule.invalidDate: Enter a valid date for "Valid on".
priceRule.customerRequired: Choose a customer, or change "Applies to".
priceRule.deactivateConfirm: Rule for {{item}}, valid {{from}} to {{to}}, stops pricing new quotation and order lines. Saved documents keep their prices. The rule stays visible as inactive and cannot be reactivated; create a new rule instead.
priceRule.deactivated: Price rule {{id}} was deactivated (version {{version}}). Its dates are free for a new rule.
priceRule.deactivateConflict: Price rule {{id}} was changed by someone else, so nothing was deactivated. The list was reloaded; check the rule and try again.
priceRule.deactivateAlreadyInactive: Price rule {{id}} is already inactive. The list was reloaded.
priceRule.deactivateUnavailable: Price rule {{id}} no longer exists in this company. The list was reloaded.
priceRule.deactivateBusy: Price rule {{id}} is being changed by another user. Nothing was deactivated; try again in a moment.
priceRule.deactivateUnknown: We could not confirm whether price rule {{id}} was deactivated (timeout). Retry to load the list before trying again.
